title.zh: 香港财库局：年内将提交条例修订草案，设立虚拟资产交易、托管发牌制度
title.en: 香港财库局：年内将提交条例修订草案，设立虚拟资产交易、托管发牌制度

current_state.zh: Hong Kong's Treasury Bureau plans to table a legislative amendment within the year establishing a licensing regime for virtual asset trading, custody, advisory and management services, while coordinating with the HKMA on legal framework improvements for detecting and removing fraud content, including AI-generated material.
current_state.en: Hong Kong's Treasury Bureau plans to table a legislative amendment within the year establishing a licensing regime for virtual asset trading, custody, advisory and management services, while coordinating with the HKMA on legal framework improvements for detecting and removing fraud content, including AI-generated material.
